description.en: A portrait comes into focus after an aurora loader, then breaks into image-colored particles that drift upward and fade.
description.zh: 极光加载后，人像逐区域变清晰；删除时，原图化为彩色粒子，向上飘散。

keywords: 图片 卡片 化尘 粒子 消散 灰烬 极光 加载 对焦 模糊 人像 image card dust disintegration particles aurora rack focus Irakkkl

useCases: 图片卡片的逐区域加载与粒子删除效果
A portrait card with an aurora loader, spatial focus reveal and sampled dust deletion
discovery.caveat: 加载、收藏与删除为本地演示；无真实AI生成或文件删除。无WebGL时降级为CSS对焦；原HTML与照片许可未核实。

source.implementation: The supplied HTML and portrait adapted to an instance-scoped DOM/WebGL/Canvas core with six native framework entries. Loading, replay, favorites and disappearance are local visual states; no AI generation or remote file deletion is performed.
source.license: No separate license was supplied or verified for the HTML or embedded portrait.

notice.en: Source packages preserve the supplied material. Redistribution rights have not been verified.
notice.zh: 代码包保留提交的素材，再分发许可尚未核实。

instructions.en: Hover or focus the portrait for Like, Replay, Download and Delete. Delete scatters the pixels; Replay image restores the local demo.
instructions.zh: 悬停或聚焦人像，可收藏、重播、下载和删除。删除后像素化尘，点击 Replay image 重播本地演示。
